notes: Launch-day Artificial Analysis read for Claude Haiku 5.5 (released 2026-10-07). AA published five effort variants (low, medium, high, xhigh, max; all labelled Default Fallback) on the release page, the model pages and the leaderboard. Each model page embeds a full model object; values here are parsed from that embedded JSON (curl with browser User-Agent, 2026-10-07), not read from a rendered chart. Same-snapshot peer rows were parsed the same way from each peer's own model page within the same retrieval session: Haiku 4.5 (reasoning), Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at the effort variants AA lists, plus cheap-tier and frontier peers from the chart on the Haiku 5.5 page. Index rows carry full precision; AA displays whole numbers. Per-evaluation rows exist for Haiku 5.5 (five efforts), Haiku 4.5 reasoning, Sonnet 5.5 (five efforts), Opus 5.5 (low, medium, max), GPT-6 Luna (all efforts and non-reasoning), GPT-6.1 Sol (low, medium, max), GPT-6 Sol max and GPT-6 Astra max. Two evaluations (CritPt, AA-LCR) have no metric id and are kept as claims. Cost per task is AA's figure at list price; for Haiku 5.5 AA states that its higher long-context tier is not reflected, so those costs are lower bounds. GPT-6 Terra is not on AA. Index scores are not comparable with other boards; keep the comparability groups.

claims.statement: Artificial Analysis lists Claude Haiku 5.5 at five explicit efforts on Intelligence Index v4.3.2: low 29.4 ($0.024/task); medium 34.5 ($0.047/task); high 37.8 ($0.079/task); xhigh 41.2 ($0.124/task); max 43.4 ($0.213/task). AA labels every variant 'Default Fallback' ('max with fallback' in chart labels). AA ranks the max variant #2 of 182 for intelligence in its price class and #46 of 182 for cost. AA's own page notes the two prices it uses ($0.10 in / $0.50 out per M, cache discount 90%) and that long-context 5x pricing is not reflected.
claims.implication: Use these as publisher-run, same-snapshot rows with explicit effort labels. Cost per task is a lower bound because AA does not apply Anthropic's long-prompt tier.

claims.statement: AA footnote on the Haiku 5.5 cost chart, verbatim: 'Claude Haiku 5.5 has 5x higher pricing on longer-context inputs which are not currently reflected; we are working to include this in cost figures across Artificial Analysis.' AA's input and output list prices for Haiku 5.5 are $0.10 and $0.50 per M tokens, so the footnote implies a higher tier (5x) for long prompts; AA does not state the threshold or the higher rate on this page. OpenRouter's API lists the same structure: $0.50/$2.50 per M above 100K prompt tokens.
claims.implication: Agentic evals in AA (Terminal-Bench, Briefcase) carry large contexts; the cost-per-task rows for Haiku 5.5 may understate real cost. Do not treat the 5x tier as primary-confirmed until Lane A reads Anthropic's pricing page.

claims.statement: Versus Haiku 4.5 (AA 'Reasoning' variant, index 16.9, $0.277/task, 18,485 output tokens/task): Haiku 5.5 low scores 29.4 at $0.024/task (11.3x cheaper per task) with 17,286 output tokens/task; medium 34.5 at $0.047 (5.9x cheaper) with 32,813 tokens/task; max 43.4 at $0.213 (1.30x) with 162,164 tokens/task. The list price ratio is 10x ($1/$5 vs $0.10/$0.50), so at low effort the per-task saving tracks the price cut, not a drop in tokens. AA states nothing about the new tokenizer; its token counts are the model's own, so a tokenizer effect cannot be separated from behavior change in this data.
claims.implication: At low and medium effort Haiku 5.5 emits about the same output tokens per task as Haiku 4.5 reasoning (about 17k to 33k against 18k), with 1.7x the index score at low and 2.0x at medium. Tokens-per-task grows steeply above medium (55k high, 89k xhigh, 162k max).

claims.statement: Same-snapshot comparison, index / cost per task. Haiku 5.5: low 29.4 / $0.024, medium 34.5 / $0.047, high 37.8 / $0.079, xhigh 41.2 / $0.124, max 43.4 / $0.213. Sonnet 5.5: low 35.9 / $0.345, medium 40.8 / $0.483, high 46.8 / $0.884. Opus 5.5: low 42.3 / $0.551, medium 51.2 / $1.336. GPT-6 Luna: low 21.5 / $0.005, medium 29.9 / $0.017, high 32.9 / $0.029, xhigh 34.6 / $0.042, max 38.1 / $0.068. GPT-6.1 Sol: low 42.1 / $0.131, medium 47.8 / $0.214. Derived from the rows in this file: Haiku 5.5 medium (34.5) is within 1.4 points of Sonnet 5.5 low (35.9) at 1/7 the cost; GPT-6 Luna matches or beats Haiku 5.5 on index per dollar at every effort tier it shares (Luna high 32.9 at $0.029 and Luna xhigh 34.6 at $0.042 vs Haiku medium 34.5 at $0.047); GPT-6.1 Sol low (42.1 at $0.131) scores about the same as Haiku 5.5 xhigh (41.2 at $0.124).
claims.implication: On AA's mix Haiku 5.5 is the cheapest Claude tier by a wide margin but not the cheapest per index point across vendors; the low-cost lane on this board is led by GPT-6 Luna. Haiku's own cost figures exclude the long-context tier, so its true cost is higher than shown.
